name: HeroVideo
description: Piqueray HeroVideo, responsive. 2.2.0 (2026-09-08, MINOR additif) : le plan Background porte enfin ses attributs de lecture (autoplay, muted, loop, playsinline, preload=metadata) — la surface livree rendait jusqu'ici une video qui ne demarrait nulle part. Le fichier video reste un asset gouverne de l'addon (jamais du contenu de page) ; seule l'affiche est du contenu, choisie par le redacteur comme une image. 2.0.0 (2026-09-02, Odoo hero pilot): re-extracted from the spec-031 set 2689:15832 (page « 031 · Planches de validation »), four `presentation` variants Mobile / Tablette / Desktop / Wide validated by the owner. Everything the canvas draws is proposed by `npm run extract:figma` and adopted as-is: layout per mode (column centered on Mobile/Tablette, row bottom-aligned on Desktop/Wide), paddings / gap / height per mode as tokensByProp on the presentation axis, the title riding the responsive text style H1 (typography.h1.* — size and line-height vary by viewport mode through tokens/modes/viewport.*). Added by hand, each named: the host element (section — not drawn), the CTA pinned to the bottom edge on Mobile/Tablette (drawn ABSOLUTE on the canvas; the dump does not carry layoutPositioning), and the CTA's right icon fixed to TRUE (the canvas shows it on Desktop/Wide only; the schema has no per-mode channel for a nested instance's prop — `propsByProp` was abandoned on 2026-08-20 — so the Odoo projection hides the glyph under the desktop breakpoint, an acknowledged deviation). The drawn widths 390/668/1200/1728 are witnesses, not tokens: the root fills its parent. Code supports a video URL and poster; Figma projects the poster as a static IMAGE placeholder. The two governed scrims belong to HeroVideo itself. Breakpoints are not in this contract: they are the token dimension `breakpoint.*` (768 / 992 / 1600), consumed by the CSS build. Plan de document : la partie titre porte la balise h1 (accessibilite-home-odoo, 2026-09-04) ; l'apparence reste pilotee par les jetons typography, axe independant du niveau.

props.name: presentation
props.description: Viewport presentation, mirroring the canvas axis Presentation. Default = mobile, the first variant of the 031 set (Figma's default) and the mobile-first base of the delivered CSS; in the delivered CSS the mode is selected by the viewport through the breakpoint tokens, never by a consumer.

props.name: backgroundUrl
props.description: Code-side poster source. On canvas, this poster is the deterministic static placeholder for the video.

props.name: videoUrl
props.description: Code-side video source. Figma's native videoHash has no contract-to-code URL transport, so the canvas intentionally uses only the static poster placeholder.

props.name: backgroundAlt
props.description: Alternative text for the decorative poster plane.

props.name: accroche
props.description: HeroVideo title. RICH text (owner rule 2026-09-02: a text drawn with a line break is rich, whether or not the set exposes a TEXT property — the 031 set draws its title on the node, no property; binding NONE). The 031 set breaks after « HÖRMANN »: explicitly on Desktop/Wide (U+2028), naturally on Mobile/Tablette. The break is a governed segment fact; WHERE the editor breaks stays content. No bold. Includes the non-breaking spaces around HÖRMANN.

default.text:
Le numéro 1 des portes HÖRMANN
en Province de Liège !

Background.description: Out-of-flow media reception plane. Code renders video plus poster; Figma renders and preserves only the static poster IMAGE. 2.2.0 (2026-09-08) : les cinq attributs de lecture sont portes ici, mesures sur l'instance jetable pilote. autoplay+muted+playsinline sont indissociables (sans muted le navigateur refuse le demarrage, sans playsinline Safari iOS passe en plein ecran) ; loop parce que c'est un fond ; preload=metadata et NON none : mesure du 2026-09-08, avec none Chrome affiche l'affiche et ne lance jamais la video (readyState 0). Le conseil de perf habituel (preload none) est donc ecarte par la mesure ; c'est l'affiche allegee qui protege le LCP.

VoileBas.description: Bottom scrim. Gradient stops read on the 031 set (2026-09-02): the veil is far stronger on Mobile/Tablette (0 → 0.8 over the full height) than on Desktop (from 50 %, to 0.6) and Wide (from 44 %, to 0.6) — literalsByProp on the presentation axis.

VoileNavigation.description: Top veil (navigation readability). Stops read on the 031 set (2026-09-02): from 75 % to 0.65 on Mobile/Tablette, from 70 % to 0.58 on Desktop/Wide — literalsByProp on the presentation axis.

Text.description: Title column. FILL width; grows to fill the row on Desktop/Wide (canvas: FILL width, Bouton HUG). On Mobile/Tablette the canvas draws it HUG-height, centered by the root — but `grow` has no per-mode channel (layoutByProp carries direction/justify/align only), so in a column the code surface stretches it vertically: THIRD named code-only fact, the Odoo projection resets flex to 0 0 auto under the desktop breakpoint.

Accroche.description: Rides the responsive text style H1: size 32/32/40/54 and line-height 40/40/50/68 by viewport mode come from typography.h1.* (tokens/modes/viewport.*), weight SemiBold. `white-space: pre-line` renders the rich prop's line break.

Bouton.description: CTA. TWO named deviations from the canvas, both because the schema has no channel for them on a nested instance (stylesWhen and layoutByProp are refused on component parts — the child contract owns its styling): (1) on Mobile/Tablette the canvas pins the CTA ABSOLUTE to the bottom edge, full width inside the horizontal padding (bottom 64, inset 24 / 48) — here it stays in the flow under the title (gap 32); the Odoo projection applies the pin under the desktop breakpoint as a code-only fact. (2) iconRight is TRUE on Desktop/Wide only on the canvas; fixed TRUE here, the Odoo projection hides the glyph under the desktop breakpoint. Both are acknowledged in the pilot journal (specs/tiny/pilote-odoo-hero-video.md) and are the two schema gaps the Odoo wave must decide on.
